ADS-B Traffic Advisory System (ATAS) is a safety feature that works through ADS-B In. While aircraft equipped with ADS-B Out broadcast their position, velocity, and altitude, ATAS uses an ADS-B In receiver to capture this data from nearby aircraft. The system then processes the information and provides aural and visual traffic alerts in the cockpit to increase pilots’ situational awareness.

By alerting pilots to potentially conflicting traffic, it helps them take timely action and thereby reduces the risk of mid-air collisions.
